strings.name: Cyrus Poonawalla
strings.summary: Raised in a Pune horse-breeding family, Poonawalla studied commerce and founded Serum Institute of India in 1966. The company expanded domestic biological production, entered international public procurement and became a major global vaccine supplier, including during COVID-19. His contribution centers on enterprise and manufacturing capacity; science, trials and operations depend on teams, partners and subsequent management.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Serum Institute of India, advancing large-scale vaccine production and global public-health supply.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born 11 May 1941 in India and raised in a Pune family.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Attended Brihan Maharashtra College of Commerce; Oxford’s 2019 doctorate was honorary.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Vaccine manufacturing at scale
strings.highlights.h1.text: Established Serum Institute and developed affordable biological production and international supply capacity.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Global public-health supply
strings.highlights.h2.text: The company supplied vaccines through WHO prequalification and UN procurement, with teams and partners.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Lifetime achievement award
strings.timeline.t1.text: Received the Economic Times Corporate Excellence 2025 lifetime award at its 2026 ceremony.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Padma Bhushan
strings.timeline.t2.text: Received India’s Padma Bhushan for contributions to trade and industry.
strings.timeline.t3.title: COVID-19 vaccine production
strings.timeline.t3.text: Serum manufactured and supplied Covishield using Oxford/AstraZeneca vaccine technology.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Oxford honorary degree
strings.timeline.t4.text: Received an honorary Doctor of Science from Oxford.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Overseas manufacturing
strings.timeline.t5.text: Serum acquired Dutch Bilthoven Biologicals, expanding polio-vaccine expertise and production.
strings.timeline.t6.title: UN supply channels
strings.timeline.t6.text: The company began exporting viral and bacterial vaccines to WHO, PAHO and UNICEF.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Biological production began
strings.timeline.t7.text: His institute began production in October, subsequently expanding vaccine types.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Founded Serum Institute
strings.timeline.t8.text: Established Serum Institute of India in Pune for domestic biological manufacturing.
